faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Ahmedabad Legal Aid Panel Lawyer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DLSA Ahmedabad Legal Aid Panel Lawyer posts is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum experience required for a Legal Aid Panel Lawyer?
faq.answer: A minimum of 2 years of experience in criminal cases at Sessions Court and Magistrate Court is required.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B) degree and be enrolled advocates with the Bar Council.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Legal Aid Panel Lawyer position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application scrutiny, shortlisting, and an interview as per NALSA Regulations 2010.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website provided in the Important Links section.

faq.answer: The job type for the Legal Aid Panel Lawyer post is Contractual.

faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the District Legal Services Authority Ahmedabad (DLSA Ahmedabad).
